description: Maps every category to its purpose, ordering position in the screening flow, and the question_ids that belong to it (from hr_screening_question_dataset.json).

introduction.name: Introduction
introduction.purpose: Confirm candidate identity, basic rapport-building, and consent to proceed with screening.

education.name: Education
education.purpose: Verify qualifications relevant to the role.

experience.name: Experience
experience.purpose: Assess relevant work history, tenure, and role fit.

skills.name: Skills
skills.purpose: Validate technical/functional skills required for the role.

location.name: Location
location.purpose: Confirm current location, relocation willingness, and work-mode compatibility.

scoring_scale.5: Critical/hard filter — auto-reject if criteria unmet
